Accordion: Related sections with single or multiple expansion.
AreaChart: Ordered magnitude as overlapping, stacked, or normalized areas.
BoxPlot: Grouped quartiles, median, whiskers, and outliers.
BubbleChart: Two numeric coordinates plus positive bubble area.
ButtonGroup: Related commands with individual tab stops.
CardCollection: Keyed static, actionable, or selectable cards.
CartesianChart: Mixed line, range, area, and column series.
ComboBox: Editable selection from local or asynchronous options.
ContextMenu: Object commands via context, keyboard, or touch gesture.
DateField: Typed ISO civil date with localized segments.
DatePicker: ISO civil date entry and calendar selection.
Dialog: Focused task or content with reversible dismissal.
DonutChart: Category shares with derived center total.
Drawer: Supplemental workflow from a viewport edge.
DropZone: File drop, paste, and picker target.
EmptyState: No data, no results, or unavailable content.
Field: Label and support a custom form control.
FileTrigger: Native file picker with type and size constraints.
FocusField: Accent surround for an opaque panel.
FormSection: Headed section of a larger form.
Heatmap: Numeric measure across two categorical domains.
Histogram: Distribution bins with an explicit ordinate.
IconButton: Familiar icon-only command with required tooltip.
InlineAlert: Feedback beside affected content or control.
LineChart: Ordered or continuous trends across series.
List: Keyed content without selection or navigation.
ListBox: Visible keyed options with keyboard selection.
MarkdownEditor: In-place formatted Markdown with syntax at cursor.
Menu: Commands from Button or IconButton trigger.
Meter: Measured quantity with units and status thresholds.
NotificationProvider: Queued notifications with count and lifetime.
PageHeader: Page identity, ancestry, status, and actions.
Pagination: Finite pages through URLs or controlled requests.
Popover: Short interactive content beside a trigger.
RadarChart: Few subjects across ordered qualities on one scale.
RangeSlider: Ordered numeric interval with non-crossing thumbs.
ResponsiveGrid: Responsive columns using preset minimum widths.
Skeleton: Loading placeholder with approximate content geometry.
Sparkline: Compact trend with current and observed-range context.
Spinner: Brief labeled busy state while active.
Table: Keyed rows, sorting, selection, and cell actions.
Tooltip: Non-interactive description of a named control.
Tree: Keyed hierarchy with expansion and optional selection.
CollapsibleNavigationPane: Grouped hierarchical destinations with compact collapse.
